Font

Cooldown

Cooldown is the typeface of this site. It starts from Comfortaa and changes what makes some readers stumble. In Comfortaa, d and q are b and p flipped over, which dyslexic readers can mix up; Cooldown can give them a rounded tail so each letter has its own shape, and letters sit a little further apart. The lowercase height adjusts for small text and kiosk screens. A wobble setting tilts each letter its own way, which this site uses instead of italics, and dots can turn into frost sparkles. It is a variable font under the SIL Open Font License, built with Python.

Features

  • Tails on d and q (stylistic set ss03): no more b/d/p/q mirrors
  • Adjustable lowercase height for small text and distant screens
  • Wobble axis: each letter tilts its own way, used instead of italics
  • Weights 300 to 700, sparkle dots (ss02) and a snowflake glyph
  • Free licence (SIL Open Font License), built from Comfortaa
